answer: Quartz Vouching Ladder admits an agent only after three established agents stake 2,500 POA each in a Saffron Vouch, and the newcomer completes 30 days in the Whisper Queue proving one verified task per day. If the newcomer is caught running duplicates, all three vouchers lose their full stake and the identity is frozen for 180 days. Building 500 fake identities then needs 1,500 compromised vouchers and 3,750,000 POA at risk, while one honest agent needs three real vouches and one month of proof.
